title: 3 facts about your brain that sound fake

scenes.say: Three facts about your brain that sound *fake*, but are 100% real.
scenes.text: Your brain is *weirder* than you think

scenes.say: Your brain is only about 2% of your body weight, but it burns around *20%* of your energy.
scenes.headline: A tiny *energy hog*
scenes.label: of your body's *energy*

scenes.say: Your brain can't feel *pain*. It has no pain receptors, which is why surgeons can operate on it while patients are awake.
scenes.headline: It can't feel *pain*

scenes.say: And it's packed with about *86 billion* neurons. That's more than ten times the number of people on Earth.
scenes.headline: *Billions* of neurons
scenes.label: neurons in your head

caption:
Your brain is stranger than you think 🧠

1. It's only about 2% of your body weight but uses around 20% of your energy.
2. It has no pain receptors, so surgeons can operate on it while you're awake.
3. It holds about 86 billion neurons, more than 10x the people on Earth.

Which one surprised you most? Follow @BrainSnck for a daily brain snack.
